mapper.select: SELECT id, sys_user_id, station_id, enabled, granted_by, reason, version FROM vi_station_grant WHERE sys_user_id = #{sysUserId} ORDER BY station_id
SELECT station_id FROM vi_station_grant WHERE sys_user_id = #{sysUserId} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY station_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vi_station_grant (sys_user_id, station_id, enabled, granted_by, reason) VALUES (#{sysUserId}, #{stationId}, 1, #{grantedBy}, #{reason})
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_station_grant SET enabled = #{enabled}, granted_by = #{grantedBy}, reason = #{reason}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), version = version + 1 WHERE sys_user_id = #{sysUserId} AND station_id = #{stationId}
